He did not provide figures on how many ships were passing through the key waterway through which about 20% of the world's oil and gas supplies flowed before the regional conflict broke out on February 28. The International Monetary Fund's Port Watch showed vessel traffic through the strait remained minimal. Wright also said it would take months after the war before normal energy flows are restored
